integrity: The all-parameter Griesmer calculation is explicit. A standalone checker replays the arithmetic identities on prime powers and directly enumerates several prime-field SR-sums; finite checks are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes the published SR-sum weight formulas for the simplex expansion, treats only linear Hamming-metric codes, excludes \(k=1\), and does not classify equivalence classes or nonlinear optimality.
title: Equal-dimension simplex SR-sums have Griesmer defect one and are distance-optimal
